blog.title: HoodCadence: never lose a recurring hood-cleaning account
blog.description: Track every restaurant against its NFPA-96 cleaning cadence, flag overdue sites, and print signed service reports after each visit.

body.text: A missed hood-cleaning rebooking is a lost account. HoodCadence keeps every recurring account on its NFPA-96 schedule so none of them slip to a competitor.

Add each restaurant with its cooking type. HoodCadence applies the NFPA-96 cadence rule automatically: solid fuel means monthly, high volume means quarterly, moderate means semi-annual, low volume means annual. Enter the last cleaning date and the tool computes the next due date. Overdue sites and jobs due within 14 days are flagged at the top.

After a visit, generate a printable NFPA-96 service report with grease-depth readings for hood, duct, and fan, deficiency notes, technician and customer signatures, and a certificate number. Marking the report also resets the cleaning date, so the schedule stays current with no extra bookkeeping.
